rationale: DD is trading at 99.8% of its intraday range after a 6.12% gap-up, essentially at the session high with the last five 1-minute candles showing stalling momentum and declining volume — classic exhaustion at resistance. The spread is wide at 22.6 bps and the stock is extended well above VWAP ($150.51) and the 9-EMA ($153.58), making a long entry at current levels high-risk with minimal reward-to-risk. A short against the high is tempting but with no news catalyst identified and 4.37x relative volume still flowing, the gap could continue to hold, so the asymmetry does not favor either direction with sufficient confidence.
